description: Danville Harvest is a farm-to-table restaurant in downtown Danville led by Executive Chef Noe Briseno, built around sustainably sourced, seasonal Bay Area ingredients with an approachable menu of shared small plates, salads and mains. It describes itself as "a pillar of the downtown community," serving weekday lunch, weekend brunch, daily dinner and a daily happy hour. Its bar program bills itself as award-winning, with seasonal craft cocktails, a "Build your own Manhattan" project and what it calls the largest whiskey selection in the Tri-Valley. The restaurant is part of restaurateur Darren Matte's group, which also runs Cocina Hermanas (Danville), Parkside Los Gatos and Per Diem (San Francisco).

notes: NAME DISAMBIGUATION: the full-service "Harvest" in downtown Danville is officially "Danville Harvest" (500 Hartz Ave). "Harvest Kitchen" at 190 Hartz Ave (DoorDash/Grubhub/Seamless listings) is a delivery-only virtual brand operated out of Vitality Bowls' store at 190 Hartz Ave Ste 150 (per NRN: "Vitality Bowls launches Harvest Kitchen hybrid virtual brand nationally" and vitalitybowls.com order pages) - not a standalone restaurant. A separate "Harvest Prep Kitchen" at 202 Sycamore Valley Rd W is marked CLOSED on Yelp. MENUS: all dishes/prices come from the June 2026 Dinner, Lunch and Brunch PDFs and the Happy Hour PDF linked from danvilleharvest.com/menu (extracted with pdftotext). Menu footnotes: bread service $4; 20% service charge for parties of 6 or more; VG/v/GF labeling. WEEKLY OFFERINGS on the home page: Sunday Fried Chicken Supper $25/person or $80 family of 4 from 5 PM; Kids Eat Free Mon-Thu 4-6 PM (free kids meal up to $11 per adult entree); Happy Hour every day 3-5 PM. GAPS/CAVEATS: Yelp, OpenTable, Tripadvisor, Toast, Uber Eats, order.online and BringFido pages returned 403/CAPTCHA to WebFetch, curl and a text proxy, so Yelp (3.9, ~1.4k) and OpenTable (4.7, 1,743 diners) ratings and the Instagram bio/follower count come from search-result snippets only; Tripadvisor 4.0 (61) and Google 4.3 (826) come from Wanderlog. The "established 2016" date is snippet-only. The OpenTable restaurant ID could not be extracted from the site's widget (loaded by JS). No dessert menu is published on the site; dessert names come from DoorDash's Sweets category (DoorDash prices are marked up). Dog-friendly status rests on Restaurantji and a BringFido listing title only. No TikTok account, live music, industry night or secret menu was found. The Happy Hour PDF was uploaded earlier (March 2026) than the June 2026 food menus. danvillesocial.com shows older hours (to 10 PM Thu-Sat) that conflict with current Google-derived hours; the current listings were used.
